name: K and E Fabrication, LLC
old_description: K&E specializes in custom project orders. From HVAC needs such as roof curbs, curb adapters, equipment stands and more, to ornamental projects such as iron fencing, railing, ladders, etc.
about:
K and E Fabrication, LLC is located at 6401 SE 74th Street in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company operates as a custom metal fabrication shop serving clients throughout the state. Details about its founding year, ownership structure, or founders are not publicly available.

The shop specializes in custom project orders, with a focus on two main product lines: HVAC components and ornamental ironwork. For HVAC systems, it fabricates roof curbs, curb adapters, and equipment stands. On the ornamental side, it produces iron fencing, railings, and ladders. The company describes its capabilities as covering a wide variety of metal products for commercial, industrial, and residential projects.

K and E Fabrication’s customer base spans commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. The company highlights commercial and residential railing projects as well as custom HVAC products for building systems. Its services are marketed across Oklahoma, targeting contractors and project managers who need fabricated metal solutions.

The firm positions itself on experience, craftsmanship, and a determination to pursue all fields of metal fabrication. It emphasizes a drive to handle diverse custom orders rather than standard catalog items.
